title: Delete _TO_DELETE (3.5 GB)?
ask: Fable moved 5,986 files that nothing uses into _TO_DELETE in the project folder; each file has a line in MANIFEST.csv giving the reason. The biggest items are 522 pre-F6.2 picture masters (1.5 GB; the WebP copies the deck falls back on are kept), the old v1/v2.0 packages, scratch folders and old review-page builds. A test build before and after the move gave the identical package. Delete the folder yourself when you're happy.

title: style_lab/ experiment renders (1.1 GB)
ask: The style experiments from September and October (F5–F6.2 surveys, spot checks). One small subfolder, research/, is still read by the pipeline and stays. Move the experiment renders to _TO_DELETE, or keep them as a record of how the style was chosen?

title: Vytis: allowed generally, or only on the president card?
ask: On 17 October you wrote that the Vytis is fine and that the Cross of Vytis 'leans patriotic, which I like'; on the courthouse you then asked for the flag instead of the cross. The code currently allows the emblem on the president card only, and everywhere else stays flag-only. Should other patriotic settings (a ceremony, the Seimas, a military band) be allowed the Vytis or the Cross where it fits?
options: Allowed where it fits, not the courthouse
